integrity: Proof relies on angular generator identities, stationary Fourier moments and Green–Kubo integration; finite rational and quadrature checks support, but do not replace, the general algebraic argument.
scientific_limitations: Exact angular-stationary Poisson orientation refresh of a planar active Brownian particle; finite-time centered displacement covariance only. Symmetric two-angle phase diagram assumes independent equal-probability orientation redraw; no spatial stationarity or rotationally isotropic full displacement law claimed. Independent scholarly priority assessment remains open.
title: Hidden second-order isotropy under noisy directional resetting
